profile.name: gb10-128g
profile.title: NVIDIA GB10 (DGX Spark and similar) with 128 GB of unified memory
profile.about: Strata's settings measured on the DGX Spark: the experts read from the model file in place, so the GPU's cache holds all of them in the one memory the CPU and the GPU share.
profile.tested: 2026-11-22 on an ASUS Ascent GX10 under StartOS 0.4.2.1: quality 61.2 / 66.2 / 46.7 / 59.8 tok/s (chat / code / story / 4K doc), 4K prompt 1,497 tok/s; at 262K context the same, a 92K-token prompt at 2,040 tok/s and a 237K-token one at 1,888 (decode 48 and 55 tok/s after them); the service peaked at 64 GiB of StartOS's 108.6 GiB line, with no throttling; switches about 70 s
notes: IQ3_S only: Q2_0 and IQ3_XXS's CPU kernels are x86-only, so there is no speed or balanced preset on ARM.

The 28.8 GB n-gram table is read from the SSD. With this much memory the page cache keeps it anyway: measured the same as --ple-io ram, which StartOS cannot lock in RAM (the container's 8 MiB RLIMIT_MEMLOCK).
The whole 262K context costs nothing measurable: the KV cache is sized at start (61 GiB at 128K, 63 at 262K) and prompts stay as fast.

The picture encoder runs on the GPU: a 1080p photo in 2.5 s, against 73 s on the CPU (10 threads). It starts with the first picture (3.5 s), stops after 120 s without one, and takes 1.1 GiB while it runs.

quality.description: IQ3_S pack, 3.5 bits/weight: task average 93.3, level with the original model
